```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
```

```{r}
df_23_24 <- read_csv("data/raw/2023-2024_NSCH_Topical_CAHMI_DRC.csv")

allfactors_23_24 <- df_23_24 |> 
  select(grades6to11_2324, ChHlthSt_2324, LowBWght_2324, PhysAct_2324, Cond2more_2324, CSHCN_2324, ADHDind_2324, ADHDSevInd_2324, ASDSevInd_2324, bullied_2324, bully_2324, MakeFriend_2324, MEDB10ScrQ5_2324, MedCare_2324, MentHCare_2324, SpEducPln_2324, ReptGrade_2324, povlev4_2324, age5_2324, sex_2324, FoodSit_2324, FoodCash_2324, HousingInstab_2324, famstruct5_2324)

df_23_24_clean <- allfactors_23_24 %>%
  filter(MedCare_2324 %in% c(1,2)) %>%
  filter(MentHCare_2324 %in% c(1,2,3)) %>%
  filter(SpEducPln_2324 %in% c(1,2)) %>%
  filter(ReptGrade_2324 %in% c(1,2)) %>%
  filter(HousingInstab_2324 %in% c(1,2)) %>%
  filter(povlev4_2324 %in% c(1, 2, 3, 4)) %>%
  filter(age5_2324 %in% c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5)) %>%
  filter(sex_2324 %in% c(1, 2)) %>%
  filter(famstruct5_2324 %in% c(1, 2, 3, 4)) %>%
  filter(FoodSit_2324 %in% c(1, 2, 3, 4)) %>%
  filter(FoodCash_2324 %in% c(1, 2, 3))
  



```
